# Customer Borrow Material Request

## Goal and approved scope

Implement the approved outbound Customer Borrow flow: stock Items only; one Customer and responsible Employee per Material Request; automatic creation of an Employee Borrow Warehouse and locked targets; partial deliveries through native Stock Entry Material Transfer and existing approval Workflow; optional expected return date; permission-aware outbound loan tracking. Return reconciliation is deferred; the report must not claim net outstanding custody.

## Plan review and ownership

The user approved the complete plan on 2026-10-04. Independent reviewer `borrow_plan_review` marked it ready with no remaining P0/P1 findings once warehouse collisions and post-review provenance immutability are covered.

- Primary: task register, hooks integration, report package, Stock navigation and tests, final gates.
- Worker `borrow_backend`: `api/erpnext/customer_borrow.py` and `api/erpnext/tests/test_customer_borrow.py`.
- Worker `borrow_ui`: four customization JSON files (Material Request, Material Request Item, Employee, Stock Entry), the existing Material Request item query, and new Material Request/Stock Entry Customer Borrow scripts.
- Read-only reviewer: independent code and test review after integration.

Approved file inventory is the final plan: the files above, `hooks.py`, `setup/workspace.py`, `setup/tests/test_workspace.py`, `connect_diagnostics_stock/report/customer_borrow_tracking/{__init__.py,customer_borrow_tracking.json,customer_borrow_tracking.py,customer_borrow_tracking.js,test_customer_borrow_tracking.py}`, this task record, and final stock documentation only after acceptance.

## Decisions and invariants

- Employee mapping is the NEW `customer_borrow_warehouse`; legacy `borrow_warehouse` and the retirement patch remain untouched.
- Company root / Borrow group / Customer Borrow - Employee ID leaf with native company suffix. Unverified same-name warehouses and ambiguous roots stop creation; never adopt, rename, delete, or move legacy inventory automatically.
- Missing warehouse creation needs native Warehouse create permission and MR create/write plus Employee visibility. Existing valid mappings can be used without Warehouse create permission. Creation and the narrow Employee mapping update share one transaction and locks.
- MR borrower, responsible Employee and destination remain immutable after submit. Stock Entry header and native row MR references are the posting provenance. Freeze borrower/provenance and stock payload after native Pending Approval/Approved or Emergency review.
- Native Stock Entry controls stock ledger, valuation, serial/batch handling and approval/Post; the custom code never auto-submits or changes MR type to impersonate Material Transfer.
- Pending quantities and custom Not Sent / Partially Sent / Sent status derive from submitted outbound quantities in stock UOM. MR-row locks prevent concurrent overdelivery. Cancellation restores pending quantities and cannot orphan a submitted delivery.
- Report rows correspond to submitted outbound Stock Entry Details, including actual posting date and optional due date. MR and Stock Entry permission conditions intersect. Return movements, estimated dates generated by the system, new loan ledgers and historical borrower reconstruction are outside scope.

## Acceptance and tests

Cover every new hook and public API: warehouse creation/idempotence/collisions/permission/company checks, Employee mapping tampering, stock-only Items, source and locked target, UOM conversion, partial sending, overdelivery and concurrency, row/header provenance, native Workflow approval and immutable reviewed payload, cancellation and optional dates. Cover report ageing/due-date/permission/cancelled-row behavior, navigation placement/idempotence and Demo/Asset Transfer regression.

All database automated tests and Computer Use acceptance target `local.test` / `dev.erp.connectdiagnostics.test`. Final static gate is `uvx --from pre-commit==4.6.1 pre-commit run --all-files`. Code review precedes final automated gates; Computer Use follows passing automated gates; canonical documentation follows runtime acceptance and independent documentation review.

## Environment evidence and blockers

The current Bench `/home/frappe-bench/frappe` contains only `dev.connectdiagnostics.local` and `e2e.connectdiagnostics.local`, not `local.test`. Read-only timezone inspection on the existing development site returned `Asia/Bangkok`. MariaDB root socket access was denied; noninteractive sudo requires authentication. No configured root credential was found. Do not repurpose or run tests on either existing site without explicit authorization. Continue implementation and static checks while preparing independent coverage; record unavailable runtime gates honestly.

## Migration and rollback

Use additive Frappe customization sync after the existing retirement patch. Required fields are conditional on Customer Borrow and do not backfill historical requests. No new migration patch or historical inventory mutation. Preserve existing Customer Demo, Asset Transfer, Workflow and unrelated dirty working-tree changes. Rollback removes new entry points/code while preserving schema, mappings, warehouses and native submitted Stock Entries; never delete posted evidence or stock.
